description: This script performs detection and repositioning of on-screen/burnt-in subtitle text by analyzing video frames with OCR, updating subtitle positions to avoid overlaps, and writing a new ASS subtitle file.

methods.name: parse_arguments()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments required for subtitle processing.

methods.name: List[int] get_frame_indices(start_ms: int, end_ms: int, fps: float, vid_total_frames: int, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates frame indices in a subtitle's time window to sample based on frame rate and sample rate.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] default_subtitle_box(frame_width: int, frame_height: int, region: str = "bottom")
methods.description: Returns the coordinates of the default subtitle region (top or bottom) based on video dimensions.

methods.name: bool text_overlap_in_box(text_results: list, box: Tuple[int, int, int, int])
methods.description: Checks OCR results to determine if any detected text overlaps with a specific bounding box.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates loading subtitles and video, detecting overlaps, adjusting subtitle positions, and saving the output.
